reviews.title: Great app, wish I could export just the photos
reviews.text: I really like this app and have a 1,000+ day streak going. One thing I'd love: being able to export just the photos from my journal entries, ideally with the date on each one so I know when it was uploaded.

reviews.title: Great App Overall
reviews.text: I love using this app daily and been doing so for many years! I think being able to customize the prompts is wonderful. My ongoing frustration is with pictures one adds with their entries. If you click on them to see the larger version, many times they won’t appear; you will just see a black screen. If the picture is from a few years ago, it won’t come up at all. This is disappointing because when a memory from 5, 7 years comes up, I would love to see the visual memory that’s attached. That’s why I take time to attach photos to every single entry. Hopefully, that glitch is resolved in the near future. Other than that, love the app!

Love the ability to add meaningful photography to entries and the daily quote. It's an investment into your mental health and wellbeing.

reviews.title: Needs Accessibility Work
reviews.text: Overall, this is an awesome app, and I plan on getting it back into my regular schedule. I love how the journaling sections are separated by morning and evening, as well as the organization of the prompts! Also, I love the challenges and quotes provided. However, the mood feature has been inaccessible with VoiceOver the entire time I have used it, which has been several years. Furthermore, some of the buttons appear to be unclearly labeled or not labeled at all now particularly in the sections related to writing an entry. This makes it difficult to know where the button to continue is and what some of the features are. Overall, though, I would recommend this app to almost anyone!

reviews.title: Mindset Shift
reviews.text: 5 months postpartum here…I’ve been struggling to see the light as every day is the same, I don’t feel like myself, and still recovering mentally and physically. Doing an entry every morning helps set the tone for my day and reminds me of the things that do bring light into my life and how I can do so for others. Simple and easy app to use.

reviews.title: Daily Diary Review
reviews.text: I absolutely love this app for its appearance and easy usage. The only thing I don’t really like is the yearly subscription however i do believe paying for it yearly is what keeps this app maintained. If I would change anything about this, I would just change the app appearance, it reminds me of the Illuminati and makes me feel very uncomfortable. Maybe into a book, a pencil, or something positive. Overall, amazing.

reviews.title: Entries Disappearing

I have been using the app for almost three years and haven’t noticed this happening before. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Losing content

As a dev myself this is a p0 to fix because users cancel subs over stuff like this. Stop adding useless features and make sure your core journal functionality works.

reviews.title: Forces their quotes onto your timelines
reviews.text:
The app is overall great. Except that what is supposed to be your personal journal… they force their random quotes onto your timeline. And even when you toggle the switch to say you don’t want them to appear… they still appear. 

I’ve been asking them for literally years to fix this, and they always say they’re going to… but never do. I’d keep the app forever otherwise, but I’m going to switch so my personal journal isn’t littered with their dumb quotes. 

So random and so frustrating, and seems like an easy thing to fix, but… yeah, they won’t.

reviews.title: Not a journal

Not what I would call a journal at all. I suppose if you just need a brief daily pick me up, it could be helpful. But I think calling it a journal is misleading.

reviews.title: Been doing for 2000 days
reviews.text: This app has been so worth it for me. A friend suggested it many years ago and I have done the morning and afternoon short journal entries ever since. I especially like that you can add photos to your journal entries. The journal prompts are useful as well.

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This journal app has truly changed my life. I’ve used it every single day for almost eight plus years as my prayer journal, gratitude journal, and daily accomplishment tracker — and I’ve rarely missed a day. That alone says everything about how meaningful and easy it is to use.

I love how the layout is simple and not time-consuming, yet still allows me to be as detailed as I want. Each morning I begin with a positive mindset, prayer requests, and intentions, and each night I end by recording my blessings and gratitude. It keeps my heart focused on what truly matters.

Being able to add photos each day has created a beautiful digital memory book alongside my written reflections. I’ve also used past entries to remember important life events, answered prayers, and milestones I might have otherwise forgotten.

This app isn’t just a journal — it’s a record of faith, growth, gratitude, and life. I can’t imagine my daily routine without it, and I recommend it to anyone who wants a meaningful, organized, and uplifting journaling experience.

reviews.title: UI/UX - From Streamlined to Cumbersome
reviews.text:
One of the core promises of the 5-Minute Journal is efficiency. It is designed to help users reflect and journal meaningfully in just five minutes. Recent changes to the user experience seem out of alignment with that purpose.

When I first started using the app, I could open it and immediately begin my evening entry. I was prompted with the mood check-in, the highlight of the day, what I learned, and my custom questions—all in a smooth, uninterrupted flow.

Now, the process is fragmented:
 * I must manually select my mood after opening the app.
 * Then, I have to choose “entry feedback” to access the highlight and learning questions.
 * Finally, I have to edit the entry again to reach my custom prompts.

This multi-step interaction interrupts the flow of journaling and makes the experience feel unnecessarily cumbersome.

I believe in the intent of this product. Please consider streamlining the experience again to preserve what made it valuable: simplicity and speed.
